question: Which of the following is the only vertically-integrated, primary copper producer in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustan Copper Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) is the only vertically-integrated copper producer in India, covering the entire spectrum of mining, beneficiation, smelting, refining, and casting of refined copper metal.
 
• It plays a significant role in the Indian copper industry, contributing to more than half of India's copper production.
 
• Being a public sector enterprise, Hindustan Copper Limited is well positioned to leverage the growing demand for copper in India and internationally.
 
• Its operations include mining copper ore, refining it into copper cathodes, and then further processing into various copper products.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Sterlite Industries
 Part of Vedanta Resources, it's a significant player in copper production but not vertically integrated like HCL.
 
 

 Jhagadia Copper Limited
 A manufacturer of copper cathodes, but lacks the vertical integration encompassing the entire production process.
 
 

 Hindalco Industries (Birla Copper)
 A leading copper manufacturer with extensive operations but not fully vertically integrated from mining to finished products.
